class_guess: Fractal: Jacobsthal transfer staircase (right) + bouncer (left), chaotic segment list
summary: Self-similar Jacobsthal transfer staircase + (010)-eating bouncer; middle phase not yet closed-form
mechanism: Right phase: transfers (01)^(T+c) (011)^T -> (011)^(T+c) (01)^T (c = 3 if T even, 2 if odd), nested as domes.
Left phase: a plain bouncer eats (010)^d, left edge +2 per bounce; one right sweep then starts the next right phase.
Between them, a record-free middle phase rebuilds the left part; its segment sizes are irregular (the open part).
